# Pull Request Title

## Description

1. **What does this PR do?**  
   - Clearly explain the changes made and why they are needed.
2. **Any related tickets/issues?** (Optional)  
   - Link to related issues, if applicable.

## Checklist

**PR submitter**, please complete the following before requesting a review:

### Code Changes

- [ ] I’ve pulled down the latest code from the `main` branch and merged it into my branch.  
- [ ] My changes do not break existing functionality in the app.  
  *(Test this by pulling down the branch, running the app, and checking basic workflows.)*  
- [ ] I’ve manually tested the affected functionality.
- [ ] I’ve removed unnecessary debug statements, logs, or commented-out code.
- [ ] I’ve added/updated dependencies in the project if applicable.  
- [ ] *(Optional)* I’ve noted areas for improvement or testing in a follow-up task.

## Review Instructions

1. Pull down this branch and run the application.
2. Verify that:  
   - Existing functionality works as expected.  
   - The described changes in this PR work correctly.  
3. Leave comments for improvement if necessary.

## Screenshots or Demo (Optional)

Attach screenshots or a short demo video if this PR affects the UI.

## Additional Notes

Add any other information the reviewer may need to understand the changes.
